of.needed: whether the environment relies on automatic Content-Type header detection from backend responses that lack explicit Content-Type

original.statement: In Traefik 3.0, automatic Content-Type header detection is removed when the backend does not set the Content-Type header; the ContentType middleware must be explicitly used to enable this detection.

decision.reason: [ev-be4f90e8abf9] says that in v3, Traefik no longer auto-detects the Content-Type header when the backend does not set it. So an environment is only affected if it is upgrading from a pre-3.0 release and relies on responses from backends that leave out Content-Type. No static configuration in the evidence shows which backends leave out the header at runtime, so it is right to combine edge-from-version <3.0.0 with an undecidable runtime-behavior-gap operand. That condition is neither too broad nor too narrow for what the evidence supports.
